rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the citrus fruit.

example.english: I bought a lemon to make lemon tea.
example.traditional: 我買咗個檸檬返嚟整檸檬茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 ning4 mung1 faan1 lei4 zing2 ning4 mung1 caa4

rows.note: Use 次貨 for a defective or inferior item, especially a vehicle, rather than for the fruit or colour.

example.english: This car is really a lemon; it broke down after just a few days.
example.traditional: 呢部車真係次貨，揸咗幾日就壞。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ce1 zan1 hai6 ci3 fo3 zaa1 zo2 gei2 jat6 zau6 waai6

rows.note: Use 檸檬樹 specifically when referring to the tree that bears lemons.

example.english: There’s a lemon tree in the backyard, and it produced lots of fruit this year.
example.traditional: 屋企後園有棵檸檬樹，今年結咗好多果。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun4 jau5 fo2 ning4 mung1 syu6 gam1 nin4 git3 zo2 hou2 do1 gwo2

rows.note: Use 檸檬黃 for the lemon-yellow colour rather than for the fruit itself.

example.english: I want to paint the room lemon yellow; it’ll look more cheerful.
example.traditional: 我想將間房油成檸檬黃，睇落精神啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 gaan1 fong2 jau4 sing4 ning4 mung1 wong4 tai2 lok6 zing1 san4 di1
